pages.title: Doom (1993 video game)
pages.extract:
Doom is a 1993 first-person shooter game developed and published by id Software for MS-DOS. Players assume the role of a space marine who fights demonic forces.
Doom was one of the most widely played games of its era.

pages.title: Half-Life 2
pages.extract:
Half-Life 2 is a 2004 first-person shooter game developed and published by Valve Corporation. It is the sequel to Half-Life (1998).
